findings.detail: lifecycle.verify_candidate(bundle, 'candidates/initial') passed before and after independent deterministic algebra. The unchanged initial freeze has no parent and revision_index 0. The decision identifies ENSANUT2018_E1_A05, candidates/initial and initial_final. Both exact hashes are bound above. No frozen artifact or decision was edited.

The actual AST expressions implement the reviewed affine law with three independent standardized Beta(3,3) components. Explicit loops provide exactly 375 rows in each female 0/1 by age 25-39, 40-54, 55-69, 70-79 cell, 3000 total. Discrete-uniform ages and unique sequential identifiers meet the declared design. Independent interval propagation gives task BMI [14.256821201014867,38.38557879898514], glucose [57.91625377015442,125.23174622984558], HbA1c [4.187408191132845,6.935937046565505]. These technical supports satisfy output restrictions; clinical tail coverage is not established.

Beta(3,3) is a proper bounded distribution; Z=(2U-1)sqrt(7) has mean zero and variance one. Bounded demographic laws and affine outputs imply finite absolute first, second and all higher moments. Independent closed-form means, covariances and raw second moments match all three retained context results. Positive residual variance budgets are 16.61468944, 78.626292 and 0.06593754656495755. Positive loading diagonals and component variances establish positive-definite population covariances and unique required projections. No generator was imported or executed.

All 30 candidate evidence items equal the supplied input and the parsed registered source extracts; registry hashes verified. The Jansen BMI slope converts as 0.13*0.09148=0.0118924 percentage points per kg/m^2 and glucose as 2.29*0.09148/18=0.01163828888888889 percentage points per mg/dL. Levels alone use the NGSP affine offset. Original/converted representations and within-cohort statistics are not independent evidence. Jansen Table 2 row-specific populations remain unresolved; their equality to Table 1 is explicitly assumed.

Every admitted non-marginal operation has one uptake record, correct source/evidence mapping, valid parameter/constraint/result paths, source population, measurement assumptions, uncertainty treatment and overlap qualification. Independent FWL and covariance solves reproduce the separately age/female-adjusted Jansen BMI and glucose projections, and the Pani age projection adjusted for female/BMI/glucose. The two Jansen projections were not substituted as joint coefficients: the joint BMI coefficient 0.004722025662320084 depends on the assumed residual correlation 0.30. Eight Pani band expectations, probabilities, numerators and raw differences were independently recomputed from the same conditional law.

Pani age-band mean differences remain +0.1315259757 to +0.3393559228 percentage points. They are exact discrepancies for the disclosed approximate source law, not source agreement, target evidence, or Monte Carlo noise. Uniform age 25-84, female probability 0.5 and the 70-84 approximation to the source's open-ended >=70 category are unsupported completion assumptions that are correctly disclosed. Source survey weights and the older tail are unreconstructed. Readiness is not conditioned on favorable source fit.

Jansen printed intervals have unknown confidence levels, and the Pani age P value supplies no SE. Fixed plug-in constraints do not propagate external estimate uncertainty. Pani band SEs remain uncertainty of survey means and are not individual SDs. Residual variation, structural assumptions and cross-population/measurement transport are distinguished. Ancestry, source recruitment, serum/plasma, assay, fasting, eligibility and medication/anemia differences remain unverified. Q3 and clinical tail coverage remain assumption dependent.

All 29 numeric target-as-source recipe checks are not_computable with null operators, all semantic bindings are unsupported with null source operators, and all retained semantic-preflight statuses are unavailable. Recipe/evidence hashes match. Source analytic calculations use separately declared demographic laws with the actual conditional equations. No target data, target results, generated rows, other candidates, trial outputs or coordinator outcome documents were read; no close or delivery action was taken.
